source.notice: This draft records requirements and proposed gameplay values from the PRD. It is not a replacement for the official Test Contract v1.0. Update the headless interface and any conflicting rules when that contract is provided.

end_conditions.win: All 5 lanterns are lit and the player is alive.
end_conditions.loss: Player health reaches 0 before completing the lantern objective.

proposed_gameplay_values.status: proposed_by_prd; subject to the official Test Contract v1.0

acceptance_tests.name: Initialize level
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: A new game starts with the player on the island and in the playing state.

acceptance_tests.name: Move player
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: W, A, S, and D move the player in their corresponding directions.

acceptance_tests.name: Jump and land
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: The player can jump while grounded, is affected by gravity, and cannot jump again before landing.

acceptance_tests.name: Collect firefly
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Contact collects a visible firefly once, increases light by the proposed amount, and awards the proposed score.

acceptance_tests.name: Respect light maximum
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Collecting fireflies at the light maximum never increases light above that maximum.

acceptance_tests.name: Light lantern without enough light
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: The lantern remains unlit and no light is consumed.

acceptance_tests.name: Light lantern with enough light
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: The lantern changes from unlit to lit once, the proposed light cost is deducted, progress increases by one, and the proposed score is awarded.

acceptance_tests.name: Do not pay twice for a lit lantern
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Interacting with a lit lantern does not consume light or award duplicate score.

acceptance_tests.name: Enemy contact damage
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: A valid enemy contact reduces health by the proposed damage amount; repeated contact during the invulnerability interval does not repeatedly damage the player.

acceptance_tests.name: Use glow skill successfully
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: With sufficient light and no active cooldown, the skill consumes its proposed cost once and repels nearby enemies.

acceptance_tests.name: Reject unavailable glow skill
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Insufficient light or an active cooldown prevents activation and does not consume light.

acceptance_tests.name: Enemy avoids lit lantern
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: The enemy avoids the safe area of a lit lantern.

acceptance_tests.name: Win after lighting all lanterns
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Lighting the fifth lantern while health is above zero changes the game state to won and stops active gameplay.

acceptance_tests.name: Lose when health reaches zero
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Health reaching zero before completing the objective changes the game state to lost and stops active gameplay.

acceptance_tests.name: Replay after terminal state
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Replay resets health, light, score, lanterns, player position, enemy, and fireflies, then returns to playing.

acceptance_tests.name: Score without duplicate rewards
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Firefly and lantern rewards are applied once per valid event; the remaining-health bonus is awarded once on victory only.

acceptance_tests.name: Run on supported platform
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: The game starts and is playable on macOS or Linux.

acceptance_tests.name: Headless contract compliance
acceptance_tests.pass_criteria: Once the official Test Contract v1.0 is available, all of its required headless scenarios, data formats, and results pass.
